reserveReview.rationale: The independent Chainlink/Moore live feed publishes one aggregate row named USD reserves (Moore Hong Kong attested), so the reviewed classification is keyed to that exact 100% live identity. Moore CPA's July 14 reasonable-assurance report preserves the underlying detail: $501.850 million held through First Digital Trust Limited and $78,900.88 of cash against $501.928901 million of total collateral, or 99.98% and 0.02%. The report values the First Digital position at reported cost and does not disclose its underlying fund instruments or fair value.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Moore CPA examination of the TUSD Consolidated Reserves Report as of July 14, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live feed exposes the attested reserve as one aggregate row. Moore's report identifies a 99.98% First Digital Trust fund position and 0.02% cash, but the aggregate row cannot be split one-to-one for live classification and the fund's assets, liquidity, counterparties, and current fair value remain undisclosed; the report also notes ongoing litigation and restrictions affecting that collateral.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The exact live row aggregates the 99.98% opaque First Digital Trust fund position with 0.02% cash. It therefore cannot support a one-to-one tracked dependency or a more granular live classification, even though the report-level split remains recorded in this review and custody profile.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report describes collateral accounts held for TUSD holders and identifies First Digital Trust, but it does not name every depository institution or establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness. It states that substantially all collateral was invested for yield and records ongoing litigation over access to the First Digital position.
